name: Wordmark closes on its one highlighted word
looks: The mark and wordmark settle together on a dark ground, a one-line promise fading in beneath with its final word picked out in a bright highlight colour, a small compatibility line and a pill-shaped CTA arriving last and lowest in the frame.
build: Mark and wordmark arrive together (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~300ms); the promise line fades in 150ms later, its last word's highlight applying as a background colour swipe rather than a text-colour change. Compatibility line and CTA pill fade in last, smallest and lowest.
sound: A soft low swell under the lockup's arrival, a light pop as the highlight swipes on.
prompt: Settle a mark and wordmark together on a dark ground, fade in a one-line promise beneath it with its final word picked out by a highlight colour swiped behind the text, then land a small compatibility note and a CTA pill last and smallest at the bottom.
